description:
I bought and tested every drywall anchor I could find, from plastic wall plugs to self-drilling anchors and heavy-duty toggle bolts, to see how much weight they actually hold and which ones are right for the job. Watch all oof my product comparisons 👉🏼https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL34cQkzKfXWbPHit6sG9uSpU8u2D_i_q- 

In this video, I'll show you how to choose and install the right drywall anchors for hanging pictures, mirrors, towel racks and heavy shelves, plus how to avoid damaging your walls and make repairs when things go wrong. 

Cheers, Jeff

#DrywallAnchors #DIYHomeImprovement #WallAnchors
